entries.name: Materials
entries.summary: Collection of model materials. Obtain from {ModraUp::Model#materials}.

entries.name: add
entries.summary: Add materials. When a name is duplicated, append a number (e.g., +Joe+ / +Joe1+). If no name is provided, use +Material+ / +Material1+.
Retrieve a material by name or its 0-based index. If not found, return `nil`.

entries.name: at
entries.summary: Alias for {#[]}.

entries.name: size
entries.summary: The number of materials that have not been deleted.

entries.name: length
entries.summary: Alias for {#size}.

entries.name: each
entries.summary: Iterate over the undeleted materials.

entries.name: unique_name
entries.summary: Returns a unique name that is not yet in use. If the base name is already in use, it appends a number to it.

entries.name: remove
entries.summary: Remove the material and clear any references from the geometry.

entries.name: purge_unused
entries.summary: Remove materials unused by live geometry and retained definitions.

entries.name: current
entries.summary: The current paint bucket material. Returns +nil+ if no material is selected.
notes: ModraUp extension. The official material dialog box often has default materials; here, it is nil when there is no current material.

entries.name: current=
entries.summary: Sets the material used by the paint bucket. Use +nil+ for the default material.

entries.name: add_observer
entries.summary: Register a {ModraUp::MaterialsObserver}. Adding the same object a second time returns +false+.

entries.name: remove_observer
entries.summary: Remove material table observers.

examples.code:
mats = ModraUp.active_model.materials
  obs = ModraUp::MaterialsObserver.new
  mats.add_observer(obs)
  mats.remove_observer(obs)

entries.name: Material
entries.summary: A material: name, color, transparency, and an optional texture. The parent class is {ModraUp::Entity}, not a Drawingelement. Textured shading is done using {#colorize_type} ({COLORIZE_SHIFT} / {COLORIZE_TINT}).

entries.name: MATERIAL_SOLID
entries.summary:
MATERIAL_SOLID = 0

{ModraUp::Material#materialType}: Solid color.

entries.name: MATERIAL_TEXTURED
entries.summary:
MATERIAL_TEXTURED = 1

{ModraUp::Material#materialType}: Textured.

entries.name: MATERIAL_COLORIZED_TEXTURED
entries.summary:
MATERIAL_COLORIZED_TEXTURED = 2

{ModraUp::Material#materialType}: colored textured material.

entries.name: COLORIZE_SHIFT
entries.summary:
COLORIZE_SHIFT = 0

{ModraUp::Material#colorize_type}: Colorize by hue shift (official default).

entries.name: COLORIZE_TINT
entries.summary:
COLORIZE_TINT = 1

{ModraUp::Material#colorize_type}：Colorize by target hue. When setting {#color=} for a material with a texture, the hue will be adjusted accordingly.

entries.name: name
entries.summary: Internal unique name. Interface display uses {#display_name}.

entries.name: name=
entries.summary: Rename. Throws an error if the name already exists for another material.
raises: [ArgumentError] Name is empty or already in use

entries.name: display_name
entries.summary: Display name. Remove square brackets when the name is in the format +[Joe]+.

entries.name: write_thumbnail
entries.summary: Write the material's color or texture thumbnail to an image file while maintaining the aspect ratio.

returns.text: Returns `true` if writing is successful, `false` if it fails, and `nil` if the parameter is invalid.

entries.name: color
entries.summary: Material color.

entries.name: color=
entries.summary: Set the color. Accepts {ModraUp::Color} or +[r, g, b]+ (0–255).
notes: ModraUp extension. {ModraUp::Color#alpha} does not write to the material; use transparency with {#alpha=}.

entries.name: alpha
entries.summary: Opacity, 0.0–1.0.

entries.name: alpha=
entries.summary: Set opacity, values outside the 0–1 range will be clamped.

entries.name: use_alpha?
entries.summary: Returns true if the material's opacity is less than 1.
notes: ModraUp extension. Does not decode patch image pixel alpha.

entries.name: texture
entries.summary: Texture. Returns nil if no texture is set.

entries.name: texture=
entries.summary:
Set the texture. `nil` clears it. The path reads in raw bytes; the default tile size is 10x10 inches. The array format is `[filename, width, height]`.

Untextured materials use the average texture color for image decoding success, displaying as a solid color; existing textures retain their color.
notes: ModraUp extension. Does not accept ImageRep; retains the original material color when no image decoding host is available.

entries.name: materialType
entries.summary: +MATERIAL_SOLID+ / +MATERIAL_TEXTURED+ / +MATERIAL_COLORIZED_TEXTURED+。

entries.name: colorize_type
entries.summary: +COLORIZE_SHIFT+ or +COLORIZE_TINT+. Readable even without a texture; defaults to SHIFT.

entries.name: colorize_type=
entries.summary: Sets the coloring method. Only accepts {COLORIZE_SHIFT} / {COLORIZE_TINT}.

entries.name: colorize_deltas
entries.summary: HLS delta from texture average color to material color: hue (degrees), saturation, lightness. Returns [0, 0, 0] when there is no texture or the pixels cannot be solved.
Returns true if the same model and slot are identical.

entries.name: Texture
entries.summary:
Texture mapping. Obtain from {ModraUp::Material#texture}. Parent class is {ModraUp::Entity}, not {ModraUp::Drawingelement}.

{#width} / {#height} are tile inches; {#image_width} / {#image_height} are pixels. {#image_rep} / {#write}(+colorize+) uses host PNG/JPEG decoding.

entries.name: filename
entries.summary: Texture path. This retains the string passed to {ModraUp::Material#texture=}.

entries.name: width
entries.summary: Tile width, inches.

examples.code:
mat = ModraUp.active_model.materials.add("Joe")
  # mat.texture = "wood.png" after assigning the texture
  # mat.texture.width == 10.0

entries.name: height
entries.summary: Tile height, inches.

entries.name: image_width
entries.summary: Image pixel width. Read from the PNG/JPEG header; defaults to 0 if not readable.

entries.name: image_height
entries.summary: Image pixel height. Read from the PNG/JPEG header; returns 0 if not readable.

entries.name: average_color
entries.summary: The average RGB values of the decoded pixels. Returns +nil+ if decoding fails.

entries.name: image_rep
entries.summary: Decodes to a {ModraUp::ImageRep}. If +colorized+ is true and the material is colored, it applies HLS colorization (SHIFT/TINT) as defined by {ModraUp::Material#colorize_type}.
raises: [RuntimeError] The texture has been deleted or cannot be decoded

entries.name: size=
entries.summary: Set the tile inch size. Use a single value to scale by the width while maintaining the aspect ratio; use an array to set the width and height separately.

entries.name: write
entries.summary: Write the texture file. If +colorize+ is false or the material is not colored, write the bytes as is; if the material is colored and +colorize+ is true, decode the bytes, then apply HLS colorization as specified by {ModraUp::Material#colorize_type} and re-encode.

entries.name: valid?
entries.summary: Returns true if the material still has a texture.

entries.name: ImageRep
entries.summary:
Pixel buffer. From file {#load_file} or {#new}(path), or {#set_data} with RGB(A) bytes.
PNG/JPEG encoding/decoding uses the host (Qt + QImage +). Without a host, {#new}(path) throws an error.

entries.name: initialize
entries.summary: Initialize with an empty buffer or decode a PNG/JPEG from a path.
raises: [ArgumentError] The path is invalid or the file cannot be decoded.

entries.name: load_file
entries.summary: Fill pixels from PNG/JPEG.
raises: [ArgumentError] The path is invalid or the file cannot be decoded.

entries.name: save_file
entries.summary: Write as PNG or JPEG. The extension determines the format; JPEG accepts +quality+ (0–100) or a hash +:quality+.

entries.name: width
entries.summary: Pixel width. An empty buffer is +0+.

entries.name: height
entries.summary: Pixel height. Empty buffer is +0+.

entries.name: bits_per_pixel
entries.summary: Bits per pixel: +8+ / +24+ / +32+. Empty buffer: +0+.

entries.name: row_padding
entries.summary: Number of bytes to fill at the end of each row.

entries.name: size
entries.summary: The number of bytes in {#data}.

entries.name: data
entries.summary: Pixel bytes (ASCII-8BIT). An empty buffer is +nil+. Byte order is RGB(A).

entries.name: set_data
entries.summary: Replace the buffer with original pixels. `bits_per_pixel` is `8` / `24` / `32`.
call_seq: image_rep.set_data(width, height, bits_per_pixel, row_padding, pixel_data) -> image_rep

entries.name: color_at_uv
entries.summary: Samples the color at UV coordinates.+(0,0)+ is the bottom-left, and +(1,1)+ is the top-right. A nil buffer returns +nil+.

entries.name: colors
entries.summary: Each pixel a {ModraUp::Color}, row-major order (top to bottom). An empty buffer is +nil+.

entries.name: Model
entries.summary: An open model document. Obtain it from {ModraUp.active_model}. Direct construction with +Model.new+ is unsupported.

entries.name: entities
entries.summary: Root drawing context of the model.

entries.name: active_entities
entries.summary: The current editing context (different from {#entities} after grouping).

entries.name: active_view
entries.summary: Current viewport. Repeated calls return a new wrapper pointing to the same camera and overlay state within the same model.

entries.name: axes
entries.summary: The current drawing coordinate axis changes with the group or component being edited.

entries.name: active_path
entries.summary:
The active path in the group or component. Returns +nil+ when editing at the root context.
Returns a copy, so modifying the array with +pop+ will not exit the edit mode.

entries.name: active_path=
entries.summary: Open a group/component path for editing. +nil+ or an empty array returns to the root context. The path must be a layer-by-layer sequence of live {ModraUp::Group} / {ModraUp::ComponentInstance} starting from the model root.
raises: [ArgumentError] Invalid path, or the path instance or another instance defined by the same definition is locked.

entries.name: close_active
entries.summary: Exit the currently active group/component layer. Returns +false+ if already at the root context.

entries.name: close
entries.summary: Close the document tab containing the model (not necessarily the current document). If +ignore_changes+ is false and the model has unsaved modifications, prompt to save; canceling keeps the document open. Closing the last document creates a new host document based on a template. After closing, the old Model and its entity objects are no longer accessible. Closing the current model without a host is equivalent to File > New.

params.name: ignore_changes
params.text: [Boolean] when true, discards unsaved changes directly

entries.name: selection
entries.summary: Current selection set. Repeatedly calling it on the same model returns the same wrapper object.

entries.name: tools
entries.summary: The tool manager for the current model.

entries.name: select_tool
entries.summary: Activates a custom Ruby tool; +nil+ returns to the select tool. Protocol follows {ModraUp::Tool}: any object that implements event methods, without needing to inherit. It will call +activate+, +deactivate(view)+, and +onSetCursor+ (if present). Re-selecting the same object will first call {ModraUp::Tool#onCancel}(+1+) and then +activate+. The viewport will then forward mouse, keyboard, VCB, +getMenu+, and +draw+ events.

params.name: tool
params.text: Create a custom tool instance; omit or use +nil+ for the select tool.

examples.title: Custom tool
examples.code:
class TipTool
    def activate
      ModraUp.set_status_text("tip")
    end
    def onMouseMove(flags, x, y, view)
      view.pick_helper.do_pick(x, y)
    end
  end
  ModraUp.active_model.select_tool(TipTool.new)

entries.name: add_observer
entries.summary: Register a {ModraUp::ModelObserver}. Adding the same object a second time returns false. Transactions, group paths, saving, and component placement will dispatch corresponding callbacks.

examples.code:
class MyModel < ModraUp::ModelObserver
    def onTransactionCommit(model)
      model.entities.length
    end
  end
  ModraUp.active_model.add_observer(MyModel.new)

entries.name: remove_observer
entries.summary: Remove the model observer.

entries.name: start_operation
entries.summary: Start a reversible operation. Should be paired with {#commit_operation} or {#abort_operation}. +disable_ui+ disables refreshing; +next_transparent+ / +transparent+ merge adjacent operations into a single undo step.

params.name: op_name
params.text: The name that appears in the undo stack

examples.code:
model = ModraUp.active_model
  model.start_operation("Line", true)
  model.entities.add_line([0, 0, 0], [1, 0, 0])
  model.commit_operation

entries.name: commit_operation
entries.summary: Commit the current operation.

entries.name: abort_operation
entries.summary: Abort the current operation and rollback.

entries.name: definitions
entries.summary: Component definition table.

entries.name: line_styles
entries.summary: Built-in line styles (12 named styles).

entries.name: materials
entries.summary: Materials table of the model.

entries.name: rendering_options
entries.summary: The display style options for the model (edges, surfaces, background, X-ray, etc.), with key names matching SketchUp.

entries.name: shadow_info
entries.summary:
model.shadow_info -> ModraUp::ShadowInfo
Model shadow parameters, local time, geographical location, and derived sun direction; modifications only redraw the viewport.

entries.name: layers
entries.summary: Layer (Tag) table. Index 0 is the default +`Layer0`+.

entries.name: active_layer
entries.summary: The current layer. Newly drawn edges and faces appear on this layer.

entries.name: active_layer=
entries.summary:
Sets the current layer. Passing +nil+ will revert to the default layer +Layer0+.
Dispatches {ModraUp::LayersObserver#onCurrentLayerChanged} when the current layer changes.

params.name: layer
params.text: Target layer, or +nil+ for the default layer.

raises: [ArgumentError] The layer has been deleted or does not belong to this model.

examples.code:
model = ModraUp.active_model
  layer = model.layers.add("Doors")
  model.active_layer = layer

examples.title: Switch back to the default layer

entries.name: pages
entries.summary: Scene page table (called scenes in the interface).

entries.name: attribute_dictionaries
entries.summary: Collection of model-level attribute dictionaries. Returns +nil+ if no dictionary exists.

entries.name: attribute_dictionary
entries.summary: Retrieve the model-level dictionary by name. Return `nil` if it does not exist and the `+create+` flag is false.

examples.code:
model = ModraUp.active_model
  model.attribute_dictionary("temp")  #=> nil
  model.attribute_dictionary("temp", true)
  model.set_attribute("temp", "k", "v")
  model.attribute_dictionary("temp")["k"]  #=> "v"

entries.name: set_attribute
entries.summary: Writes a model-level attribute. An empty dictionary name or key raises an error. Inside {#start_operation}, the write is committed or aborted with geometry changes. Otherwise it creates a separate history entry. Values retain their type when read back. For structured data, use +JSON.generate+ in Ruby and pass the resulting string.

params.type: Boolean, Integer, Float, Length, String, Time, Array, Geom::Point3d, Geom::Vector3d, nil
params.name: value

raises: [ArgumentError] empty dictionary name or empty key
[TypeError] Hash, Symbol values, entities, etc., are unsupported types

examples.title: Convert the Hash to a JSON string.

entries.name: get_attribute
entries.summary: Read the model-level attribute. If +dict_name+ and +key+ are Symbols, convert them to strings. Return +default+ if the dictionary or key is missing. The return value type is the same as that written by {#set_attribute}.

examples.code:
model = ModraUp.active_model
  model.set_attribute("temp", "k", "v")
  model.get_attribute("temp", "k")  #=> "v"
  model.set_attribute("temp", "n", 0)
  model.get_attribute("temp", "n")  #=> 0
  model.get_attribute("temp", "missing", "x")  #=> "x"

entries.name: delete_attribute
entries.summary: Delete the entire model-level dictionary, or delete a specific key.

entries.name: path
entries.summary: Path to the saved file. Returns an empty string if the file has never been saved.

entries.name: name
entries.summary: The name of the Model Info, independent of the file path and {#title}; it is an empty string if not set.

entries.name: entityID
entries.summary: Like SketchUp, the model does not have a numeric ID; it returns a string +"Model"+. The entities within the model use {ModraUp::Entity#entityID} (an integer starting from 1).

entries.name: find_entity_by_id
entries.summary: Find an entity by its {ModraUp::Entity#entityID}; a string parameter finds a group/component instance by GUID. Pass a single parameter to return an entity or +nil+, pass multiple or an array to return an array of the same order (with +nil+ at positions where no entity is found). entityID is valid only for the current session.
raises: ArgumentError when no parameters are provided.

examples.code:
model = ModraUp.active_model
  edge = model.entities.add_line([0, 0, 0], [9, 9, 9])
  model.find_entity_by_id(edge.entityID) == edge  #=> true

entries.name: find_entity_by_persistent_id
entries.summary:
Find by {ModraUp::Entity#persistent_id}. The persistent_id is saved with the model and remains unchanged upon reopening.
Use boolean keywords to limit the scope: +entities+, +definitions+, +layers+, +layer_folders+, +materials+, +pages+ (when any range is given, only search within the ranges set to +true+).
raises: ArgumentError when no parameters are provided.

examples.code:
model = ModraUp.active_model
  pid = model.entities.add_line([0, 0, 0], [9, 9, 9]).persistent_id
  model.find_entity_by_persistent_id(pid, entities: true)

entries.name: valid?
entries.summary: Returns true if the associated model is not yet closed; models opened in the background remain valid.

entries.name: deleted?
entries.summary: Opposite of {#valid?}.

entries.name: typename
entries.summary: Fixed as +"Model"+.

entries.name: guid
entries.summary: Model version GUID. It will be updated and saved with the file upon successful modification.

entries.name: title
entries.summary: Not saved as a string null value, saved as a filename (without extension).

entries.name: bounds
entries.summary: The world bounding box of the model content.

entries.name: edit_transform
entries.summary: Returns the transformation from the current editing context to world coordinates. At the model root it is the identity transformation.

entries.name: modified?
entries.summary: Has the model been modified since the last save.

entries.name: number_faces
entries.summary: The number of live faces in the model.

entries.name: raytest
entries.summary: Find the first hit along the ray (face or edge, including coplanar boundaries). The ray is given as `[point, vector]`; the second item is a Point3d when specifying two points to determine the direction; a numerical array is interpreted as a vector, and if normalization is not possible, the second item is treated as a point. On hit, returns `[Geom::Point3d, Array]` (point and instance path), and if no hit, returns `nil`. The `wysiwyg_flag` is default `true`; set to `false` to also query hidden entities and geometry within hidden instances.
raises: [ArgumentError] The ray is not a two-item array.

entries.name: save
entries.summary: Save the model. If no path is specified and it has not been saved before, raise an ArgumentError (no dialog). The SKP writer currently only supports the 2017 format; explicitly specifying another version will return false.
raises: [ArgumentError] The model has not been saved and no path was specified.

entries.name: save_copy
entries.summary: Save a copy, preserving the path, dirty state, and original model GUID. Explicitly specified versions are currently supported only up to VERSION_2017.

entries.name: export
entries.summary: Exports the model without changing {#path}. The desktop host uses its CAD plugin for 3D DWG and DXF. Other supported formats include .skp, .osk3d, GLB, OBJ, and STL. The host accepts and ignores +show_summary+ or an options Hash.

params.name: options
params.text: Boolean values are equivalent to +show_summary+ (default is false), controlling the result window after success; +nil+ is equivalent to omitting it. Hash keys can be Symbol or String, and hash values do not accept +nil+.

Millimeters are also accepted as millimeter or millimeters. +min_arc_edge_mm+ specifies the arc segment edge length in millimeters, with a range of 0.001 to 1e9, and a default value of 5.0.

entries.name: OptionsManager
entries.summary: Model options collection. Its providers, in order, are +"PageOptions"+, +"SlideshowOptions"+, and +"UnitsOptions"+. The first two control scene transitions and slide duration under Model Info → Animation. The third reads and writes the model's unit settings.
notes: ModraUp extension. SketchUp has "+PrintOptions+" and "+NamedOptions+", but this host does not.

entries.summary: Returns the option provider by name or index. Index 0/1/2 correspond to "PageOptions", "SlideshowOptions", "UnitsOptions"; others are nil.

entries.name: OptionsProvider
entries.summary:
A set of name/value options retrieved from {ModraUp::Model#options}.

- +"PageOptions"+: +ShowTransition+ (Boolean, whether to enable scene transition), +TransitionTime+ (seconds).
- +"SlideshowOptions"+: +LoopSlideshow+ (Boolean, play from the beginning after the last slide), +SlideTime+ (seconds per slide).
- +"UnitsOptions"+: +LengthUnit+ / +LengthPrecision+ read/write the core unit, +LengthFormat+ fixed to {Length::Decimal}.

When a scene's {ModraUp::Page#transition_time} / {ModraUp::Page#delay_time} is negative, the seconds from the first two groups are used.
notes: ModraUp extension. Kernel options omit feet and yards, independent area and volume settings, snapping, and PrintOptions.

entries.summary: Return the value by key name or index. Unknown keys return +nil+.

Write the option. Returns the written value if successful, returns +false+ for unsupported keys or values like feet or yards. 

Unit options take an Integer; animation switch takes a Boolean, and seconds take a non-negative number.
raises: [TypeError] The unit value is not an Integer, or the duration is not a number.

entries.name: Overlay
entries.summary:
Viewport overlay layer. Not a {ModraUp::Entity}. Subclasses implement +draw+ / mouse callbacks, then add to the model via {ModraUp::OverlaysManager#add}.
The overlay layer is enabled by checking it in the 'Window › Tray Window › Overlays' menu; once {#enabled=} is true, the viewport calls +draw(view)+ every time it refreshes.
The overlay layer's drawings cannot be picked or exported.

Each model has a {ModraUp::OverlaysManager}. To appear in all documents, create an instance in {ModraUp::AppObserver} and add it in +onNewModel+ / +onOpenModel+.

examples.code:
class DemoOverlay < ModraUp::Overlay
    def initialize
      super("demo.overlay", "Demo", description: "Write in the upper-left corner of the viewport")
    end

    def draw(view)
      view.draw_text([20, 20, 0], "Demo overlay")
    end
  end
  ov = DemoOverlay.new
  ModraUp.active_model.overlays.add(ov)

entries.name: initialize
entries.summary: Construct with source inferred by call stack {#source}: take the extension name of the registered file folder where the calling file is located.

examples.code:

    end
  end

entries.summary: The unique ID passed during construction.

examples.code:

entries.summary: Panel display name.

entries.summary: Panel description, displayed below the list when this line is selected.

examples.code:

    end
  end

entries.summary: Modify the description. The overlay refreshes in the viewport when added to the model.

    end
  end

  ov.description = "x"

entries.summary: Toggle the overlay layer on or off, which is the same as the checkbox in the palette. Call {#start} when turning on and {#stop} when turning off; do nothing if the state does not change.
raises: [RuntimeError] The overlay has not been added to the model, or it has already been {ModraUp::OverlaysManager#remove}.

examples.code:

entries.summary: After removing an overlay with ModraUp::OverlaysManager#remove, its validity becomes +false+ and it cannot be added back.

entries.name: source
entries.summary: The overlay layer comes from which extension: determined by the {SketchupExtension#name} found at the time of construction. It is displayed in the tray as "Extension: Name". If not in any registered extension's folder (e.g., created in the Ruby console), it is an empty string.

examples.code:
class DemoOverlay < ModraUp::Overlay
    def initialize
      super("demo.overlay", "Demo")
    end
  end
  DemoOverlay.new.source  #=> "" (created in the console)

entries.name: start
entries.summary: Called when the overlay is enabled through its checkbox or {#enabled=}. Attach observers and prepare caches here. The base implementation does nothing.

examples.code:
class DemoOverlay < ModraUp::Overlay
    def initialize
      super("demo.overlay", "Demo")
    end
    def start
      @cache = []
    end
  end

entries.name: stop
entries.summary: Called when the overlay is disabled or removed through {ModraUp::OverlaysManager#remove} while enabled. Detach observers and clear caches here. The base implementation does nothing.

examples.code:
class DemoOverlay < ModraUp::Overlay
    def initialize
      super("demo.overlay", "Demo")
    end
    def stop
      @cache = nil
    end
  end

entries.name: draw
entries.summary:
Callback (subclass implementation): Called every time the viewport is refreshed while the overlay is active. Only draw the cached data and do not perform any recomputation here.
Overlay layers are drawn in the order of the tray list from top to bottom, with later-drawn layers overlaying earlier-drawn ones.

examples.code:
class DemoOverlay < ModraUp::Overlay
    def initialize
      super("demo.overlay", "Demo")
    end
    def draw(view)
      view.drawing_color = "red"
      view.draw2d(GL_LINES, [[10, 10, 0], [200, 10, 0]])
    end
  end

entries.name: onMouseMove
entries.summary: Implement this callback to track pointer motion within the viewport while the overlay is enabled, regardless of the active tool. Coordinates are in logical pixels. Keep this frequent callback lightweight.

examples.code:
class DemoOverlay < ModraUp::Overlay
    def initialize
      super("demo.overlay", "Demo")
    end
    def onMouseMove(flags, x, y, view)
      @mouse = [x, y, 0]
      view.invalidate
    end
  end

entries.name: onMouseEnter
entries.summary: Called when the pointer enters the viewport while the overlay is enabled. Implement this callback in a subclass.

examples.code:
class DemoOverlay < ModraUp::Overlay
    def initialize
      super("demo.overlay", "Demo")
    end
    def onMouseEnter(flags, x, y, view)
      @inside = true
    end
  end

entries.name: onMouseLeave
entries.summary: Called when the pointer leaves the viewport while the overlay is enabled. Implement this callback in a subclass.

examples.code:
class DemoOverlay < ModraUp::Overlay
    def initialize
      super("demo.overlay", "Demo")
    end
    def onMouseLeave(view)
      @inside = false
      view.invalidate
    end
  end

A list of {ModraUp::Overlay} for a model, ordered as they appear in the tray and the drawing order. The same +overlay_id+ cannot be added twice.
After the user rearranges the overlays in the tray, remember the order by id. On subsequent additions, insert them at the remembered position.

entries.summary: Remove the overlay layer and set its {ModraUp::Overlay#valid?} to false. The overlay will first receive a {ModraUp::Overlay#stop} event if it is open.

entries.summary: The model's scene pages table. Obtain it from {ModraUp::Model#pages}. It includes Enumerable.

entries.name: add
entries.summary: Add a new page using the current camera and layer visibility state, and select it. If the name is a duplicate, it will be renamed to avoid conflict. Omitting +flags+ sets it to {PAGE_USE_ALL}.

params.name: index
params.text: The new scene's position (starting at 0); if out of range, it is added to the end.

entries.summary: Delete a page.

entries.name: selected_page=
entries.summary:
Select the scene and apply its camera, shadows, and layer visibility immediately. No transition animation is played.

The camera read immediately after setting is the camera of that scene. The scene tag in the interface and +ModraUp.send_action("pageNext:")+ update with the scene when +model.options["PageOptions"]+ is set to play a transition in the view › animation.
notes: ModraUp extension. SketchUp animates the scene transition when it is enabled; this host always switches immediately.

examples.code:
pages = ModraUp.active_model.pages
  a = pages.add("A")
  b = pages.add("B")
  pages.selected_page = a

entries.summary: Register a {ModraUp::PagesObserver}. Adding the same object a second time returns +false+.

entries.name: add_frame_change_observer
entries.summary:
Register a global {ModraUp::FrameChangeObserver}. The +frameChange+ method is called when switching scenes.
Returns an integer ID to be passed to {ModraUp::Pages.remove_frame_change_observer}.

entries.name: remove_frame_change_observer
entries.summary: Remove the observer by the id returned from {ModraUp::Pages.add_frame_change_observer}.

entries.name: unique_name
entries.summary: Generate a unique scene name based on the root name. If the name is already in use, append a number to it.
notes: ModraUp extension. In case of conflict, it is +"Joe1"+, not SketchUp's +"Joe 2"+.

entries.name: slideshow_time
entries.summary: Slide Show Total Time: Includes the seconds for transitions and holds of scenes that are included in the animation. If a scene's own time is negative, it defaults to the model's default time ({ModraUp::Page#include_in_animation?} / {model.options["PageOptions"]} / {["SlideshowOptions"]}). If scene transitions are disabled, the transition time is counted as 0.

entries.name: show_frame_at
entries.summary:
Display the slide at the frame after +seconds+ seconds: Select the scene at that moment and apply it. The camera position is set to the corresponding position from the previous scene to the current one (consistent with the easing during playback). The timeline is as follows: the first scene stays for the delay time, followed by each scene transitioning and then staying, and finally transitioning back to the start from the first scene, with a total length of {#slideshow_time}; scenes outside the range are ignored. Only scenes where {ModraUp::Page#include_in_animation?} returns true are considered.

Return the displayed scene and the transition progress (0.0–1.0, 1.0 for staying). If no scenes are included in the animation, return +nil+. Trigger {ModraUp::FrameChangeObserver#frameChange}.

examples.code:
pages = ModraUp.active_model.pages
  pages.add("Page 1")
  pages.add("Page 2")
  page, ratio = pages.show_frame_at(1.8)

  a = pages.add("A")

  pages.reorder(a, 1)

entries.name: Page
entries.summary: A page scene (the scene tab in the interface). The camera and hidden layers are saved by the core; axes, styles, shadows, and section planes have no associated data.

entries.name: name
entries.summary: Name on the scene tab.

entries.name: name=
entries.summary: Renames the page. If the name is already taken, the host generates a unique name.

entries.name: description
entries.summary: Documentation in the Scene Manager.

entries.name: description=
entries.summary: Set the description.

entries.name: camera
entries.summary: The camera on this page. Changing it will write back to the scene; if this page is the currently selected one, the viewport will update accordingly.

entries.name: shadow_info
entries.summary: Returns the {ModraUp::ShadowInfo} settings saved with this scene, independently of the model's current shadow settings. The scene's +use_shadow_info?+ flag controls whether switching to the scene applies them.

entries.name: delay_time
entries.summary: Slide duration in seconds. New scenes use +-1+ to inherit the model default from +model.options["SlideshowOptions"]["SlideTime"]+.

entries.name: delay_time=
entries.summary: Set the number of seconds to pause.

entries.name: transition_time
entries.summary: The number of seconds for the transition to this page. A new scene of +-1+ indicates using the model's default transition time (model.options["PageOptions"]["TransitionTime"]).

entries.name: transition_time=
entries.summary: Set the transition time in seconds.

entries.name: include_in_animation?
entries.summary: Does this page appear during the animation playback («View › Animation › Play»).

entries.name: include_in_animation=
entries.summary: Set whether to include in animation.

entries.name: layers
entries.summary: The layers on this page that are hidden. If layer visibility is not used, it defaults to +nil+.

entries.name: layer_folders
entries.summary: The hidden layer folders on this page. Returns `nil` if layer visibility is not in use.

entries.name: set_visibility
entries.summary: Sets whether layers or layer folders are visible on this page. Only changes the scene's saved content and does not affect the current viewport.

examples.code:
model = ModraUp.active_model
  page = model.pages.add("Plan")
  page.set_visibility(model.layers.add("Doors"), false)
  page.set_visibility(model.layers.add_folder("Furniture"), false)

entries.name: get_drawingelement_visibility
entries.summary: The element is visible on this page (for hidden geometry/scenes saved). Uncontrolled elements (ordinary geometry in groups or components) return +true+.
raises: [ArgumentError] The element does not belong to this model.

entries.name: set_drawingelement_visibility
entries.summary: Sets the visibility of elements on this page, only modifying the scene's saved content. Controlled are the drawing elements at the model root («top-level hidden geometry») as well as groups and components at any level («hidden objects»); other elements return false.
raises: [ArgumentError] The element does not belong to this model.

examples.code:
model = ModraUp.active_model
  group = model.entities.add_group
  group.entities.add_line([0, 0, 0], [1, 0, 0])
  page = model.pages.add("Plan")
  page.set_drawingelement_visibility(group, false)
  page.get_drawingelement_visibility(group)  #=> false

entries.name: hidden_entities
entries.summary: The hidden drawing elements on this page. Only lists ordinary geometry when hiding geometries, and only lists groups and components when hiding objects; returns +nil+ if neither is hidden.

entries.name: rendering_options
entries.summary: The rendering style saved for this page. Reading and writing is a scene snapshot, not modifying the current view; it becomes effective when switching to this scene and applying the style. Unsaved scenes read the current model values, and the first write saves the current model style as the base.

entries.name: update
entries.summary: Updates the page in the current viewport. Omitting the flag uses {PAGE_USE_ALL}. The camera is set to the current {ModraUp::View#camera}; layer visibility copies the current hidden layers.

entries.name: model
entries.summary: The model it belongs to.

entries.name: parent
entries.summary: Parent scene table.

entries.name: deleted?
entries.summary: Returns true after being deleted from the scene table.

entries.name: valid?
entries.summary: If the page is valid, it returns true.

entries.name: typename
entries.summary: Fix +Page+.

entries.name: use_camera?
entries.summary: Returns whether the camera is saved.

entries.name: use_camera=
entries.summary: Returns whether the camera is saved.

entries.name: use_rendering_options?
entries.summary: Whether to save the drawing style. The scene page does not save {ModraUp::RenderingOptions} separately; switching scenes does not change the style.

entries.name: use_rendering_options=
entries.summary: Whether to save the drawing style flag.

entries.name: use_shadow_info?
entries.summary: Does whether to apply the page's shadow parameters when switching scenes.

entries.name: use_shadow_info=
entries.summary: Controls the saving and application of shadow parameters for this page; update re-captures the current parameters.

entries.name: use_axes?
entries.summary: Whether to save the axes. This kernel has no Axes data.

entries.name: use_axes=
entries.summary: Whether to save axis flags.

entries.name: use_hidden?
entries.summary: Returns whether hidden geometry is saved (for the merged flag prior to 2019).

entries.name: use_hidden=
entries.summary: Whether to save hidden geometry flags.

entries.name: use_hidden_layers?
entries.summary: Whether to save layer visibility.

entries.name: use_hidden_layers=

entries.name: PagesObserver
entries.summary: Scene table observer. Registered via {ModraUp::Pages#add_observer}.

examples.code:
class MyPages < ModraUp::PagesObserver
    def onElementAdded(pages, page)
      page.name
    end
  end
  ModraUp.active_model.pages.add_observer(MyPages.new)

entries.name: onElementAdded

examples.code:
class MyPages < ModraUp::PagesObserver

      page.name
    end
  end

entries.name: onElementRemoved

examples.code:
class MyPages < ModraUp::PagesObserver

    end

entries.name: onContentsModified
entries.summary: Called when the contents of the scene graph or the currently selected page changes.

examples.code:
class MyPages < ModraUp::PagesObserver

    end
  end

entries.name: FrameChangeObserver
entries.summary:
Scene Transition Observer. Registered via {ModraUp::Pages.add_frame_change_observer}.
This host does not play animations, invoking +frameChange(from, to, 1.0)+ once.

examples.code:
class MyFrame < ModraUp::FrameChangeObserver
    def frameChange(from_page, to_page, percent_done)
      percent_done
    end
  end
  id = ModraUp::Pages.add_frame_change_observer(MyFrame.new)
  ModraUp::Pages.remove_frame_change_observer(id)

entries.name: frameChange
entries.summary: Scene change progress. When there is no animation, +percent_done+ is 1.0.

examples.code:
class MyFrame < ModraUp::FrameChangeObserver
    def frameChange(from_page, to_page, percent_done)
      percent_done
    end
  end

entries.name: Sketchup
entries.summary: Compatibility alias for {ModraUp}.
notes: ModraUp extension.

entries.name: PickHelper
PICK_INSIDE
entries.summary: {#window_pick} / {#boundingbox_pick}: The entity is completely inside the box.

entries.name: PICK_CROSSING
entries.summary: {#window_pick} / {#boundingbox_pick}: The element intersects with the box to be picked.

entries.name: do_pick
entries.summary: Picks at screen coordinates and returns the number of pick records. The +aperture+ argument gives the side length of a square. Omit it or pass 0 to use the viewport's default click tolerance. If an edge takes priority, the results also include the face under the cursor and its path. The first record remains the native selection tool's best hit.

entries.name: init
entries.summary: Record the screen coordinates and square aperture for subsequent multiple {#test_point} calls (only pass model points). The aperture is the width and height of the square in pixels; omit or use 0 for the default 5. No need to call {#do_pick} first.

entries.name: test_point
entries.summary: The projected model point falls within a square centered at +(x, y)+ with side length +aperture+. The single-parameter form must be initialized with {#init}; it is independent of the result of {#do_pick}.

examples.code:
view = ModraUp.active_model.active_view
  ph = view.pick_helper
  scr = view.screen_coords([0, 0, 0])
  ph.init(scr.x, scr.y)
  ph.test_point([0, 0, 0], scr.x, scr.y, 40)

entries.name: count
entries.summary: The number of hits from the most recent {#do_pick} / {#window_pick} / {#boundingbox_pick}.

entries.name: path_at
entries.summary: The +index+th pick path: from the current edit context group/instance to the leaf element. Out of bounds returns +nil+.

entries.name: all_picked
entries.summary: The first element of each pick path in the current editing context. Nested hits will repeat groups/instances.

entries.name: best_picked
entries.summary: The frontmost hit in the current editing context (a group/instance or face/edge).

entries.name: view
entries.summary: The viewport to which this picker belongs.

entries.name: leaf_at
entries.summary: The leaf geometry at the +index+ path (typically a face or edge).

entries.name: element_at
entries.summary: The +index+th path in the current edit context, corresponding to the item picked by {#all_picked}.

entries.name: depth_at
entries.summary: The depth (path length) of the path at index +index+. Out of bounds returns 0.

entries.name: transformation_at
entries.summary: Transform the leaf geometry coordinates to the current edit context's transformation. Out-of-bounds results in +nil+.

entries.name: picked_face
entries.summary:
The best face from the most recent {#do_pick}. Must precede a {#do_pick}.
Returns the face corresponding to a {#path_at} record; returns nil if no face is hit.

entries.name: picked_edge
entries.summary: The best edge from the most recent {#do_pick}. Must be called after {#do_pick}.

entries.name: picked_element
entries.summary: The best non-face-non-edge element (usually a group or component instance). With +index+, it refers to the element at that position in the path.

entries.name: pick_segment
entries.summary:
Determine if a pick segment falls within the screen aperture. Returns the index starting from 0 if a point is hit; returns -1, -2, etc., if a segment is hit. Returns +false+ if not hit.

The single-parameter form must be initialized with {#init}. It is unrelated to {#do_pick}.
call_seq: pick_helper.pick_segment(points, x, y, aperture) -> Integer, false

entries.name: window_pick
entries.summary: Rectangle screen pick. Ignore +z+. +pick_type+ is {PICK_INSIDE} or {PICK_CROSSING}. Hits are recorded, then use {#all_picked} to get the current context elements.

entries.name: boundingbox_pick
entries.summary: Pick using the bounding box in model space. The +transformation+ is applied to the box. The result is also added to {#all_picked}.

examples.code:
bb = Geom::BoundingBox.new
  bb.add([0, 0, 0], [10, 10, 10])
  ph = ModraUp.active_model.active_view.pick_helper
  ph.boundingbox_pick(bb, ModraUp::PickHelper::PICK_CROSSING)

entries.name: __mu_version
entries.summary: Internal: The edit count for this group of entities, incremented with each modification. Used by the process to determine if an entity has been modified (via +run_procedures(:if_modified)+). Only meaningful within the current session and not saved with the file.

entries.name: __mu_operation_open?
entries.summary: Internal: Is there an uncommitted operation currently open (between +start_operation+ and +commit_operation+)? The process runs within the open operation without creating a new one.

entries.name: PROCEDURE_ID_FOLLOW_ME
entries.summary: The native process Follow Me's id (in the string form of +ComponentDefinition#attach_procedure+).

entries.name: PROCEDURE_ID_SOLID_TOOLS
entries.summary: The native procedure ID for solid tools (union, difference, intersection).

entries.name: PROCEDURE_ID_COPY_ALONG
entries.summary: The native process ID for "Copy Along" in Ruby SketchUp.

entries.name: register_procedure
entries.summary: Register a procedure in the current session. Registering the same instance or the same ID again returns `false`. Only the procedure's ID and parameters are stored in the model. When the file is opened, the procedure must be registered; otherwise, `get_procedure_parameters` returns an empty value and `run_procedures` does not run, preserving any existing output geometry.

entries.name: initialize
entries.summary: Abstract base class. Subclasses call `super` in `initialize`, providing a unique ID (e.g., `{Company.Extend.Procedure}`), a visible name, and an integer version.
raises: [TypeError] id / description is not a String, or version is not an Integer
[ArgumentError] id or description is empty, or missing keywords

examples.code:
class Fence < ModraUp::Procedure
    def initialize
      super(id: 'example.fence', description: 'Fence', version: 1)
    end
  end

entries.name: declare_params_and_ui
entries.summary: Must be implemented. Returns a JSON object string: keys are parameter IDs (matching the keys in +attach_procedure+), values are control descriptions. This procedure reads these fields: +type+ (number/length/angle/integer/boolean/checkbox/string/text/dropdown/choice/button), +label+, +default+, +min+, +max+, +step+, +options+ (string, or {value, label}), +group+. Buttons are not parameters. Args: +:model+.

entries.name: validate
entries.summary: Must be implemented. Args: +:model+, +:control_entities+, +:parameters+ (Symbol keys). Do not modify the model. Return +true+, +false+, or an error Hash array (+:title+, +:description+, +:involved_entities+).

entries.name: run
entries.summary: Must be implemented. Args: +model+, +definition+, +parameters+. Call within the operation started by this procedure; do not call +start_operation+. Clear +definition.entities+ (i.e., clear the output), then generate geometry. Return value is the same as for #validate; revert the entire step on failure.

examples.code:
def run(args)
    ents = args[:definition].entities
    ents.clear!
    ents.add_line([0, 0, 0], [args[:parameters][:length], 0, 0])
    true
  end

entries.name: draw
entries.summary: Optional. Called every time the view is refreshed when the component is opened for editing, to draw the preview. Args: `+model+, +view+, +control_entities+, +parameters+`.

entries.name: get_extents
entries.summary: Optional. #draw Returns the extent when drawing outside the component; defaults to an empty bounding box. Drawing or modifying the model is not allowed.

entries.name: get_widget_states
entries.summary: Optional. Control id → {enabled:, visible:}; omitted controls remain unchanged. Args: +model+, +parameters+.

entries.name: on_button_clicked
entries.summary: Optional. The button control was clicked. Args: +:model+, +:definition+, +:button_id+, +:parameters+. Perform an operation on the model when modifying it. Return +:reload_ui+ to rebuild the control.

entries.name: on_open_close
entries.summary: Optional. Component opens or closes for editing. Args: `+action+` (`+:open+` / `+:close+`), `+from_undo_redo+,` `+model+,` `+definition+.` Only observe, do not modify the model.

entries.name: attach_procedure
entries.summary: Converts the definition to a procedural component. Existing entities become control entities in a hidden inputs group, and {#entities} exposes the output. Specify a registered procedure or its ID in +procedure+. Keys in +parameters+ must be declared by the procedure. Omitted parameters use their declared +default+. If validation or execution fails, the operation is rolled back and raises ArgumentError.
raises: [TypeError] ComponentDefinition is already a procedure, parameter is not a Hash, value type not supported
[ArgumentError] The ID is not registered, native procedure not declared, parameters not defined, validated, or failed to run.

entries.name: procedural?
entries.summary: Added Ruby procedures, or generated by native process tools. Parameters components (node graphs) do not count.

entries.name: control_entities
entries.summary: Input entities for a process component.

entries.name: get_procedure_parameters
entries.summary: Current parameters (Symbol keys). An empty Hash when the process is not registered in this session.

entries.name: set_procedure_parameters
entries.summary: Merge parameters and regenerate the output in one step. Undo on failure, rolling back the entire step and raising an ArgumentError.
raises: [TypeError] The component is not a process component, or the value type is not supported.
[ArgumentError] Parameter not declared, process not registered, failure in native process validation or execution.

entries.name: run_procedures
entries.summary: +:if_modified+ runs the procedure only if the control entity has been modified;+:force+ runs the procedure regardless. If no procedures are registered, nothing happens.
raises: [ArgumentError] mode is not +:if_modified+ / +:force+, or the operation failed.

entries.name: make_non_procedural
entries.summary: Remove Procedural: +:keep_output+ Keep Output (keep input when output is empty), +:keep_input+ Keep Control Entity. One undo step.
raises: [TypeError] The component is not procedural, or the parameter is not a Symbol.

entries.name: RegionalSettings
entries.summary: Host regional format: decimal point and list separator.

entries.name: decimal_separator
entries.summary: The decimal point used in the current locale (typically either `.` or `,`).

entries.name: list_separator
entries.summary: List separator. Use a semicolon when the decimal point is a comma, otherwise use a comma.

entries.name: RenderingOptions
entries.summary:
The display style of the model (line style, surface, background, section plane, X-ray, etc.) is stored and retrieved in the form of a key-value table.
It is obtained from {ModraUp::Model#rendering_options}, with one set per model. The keys and value types match those in SketchUp 2026, and changes are saved with the model (OSK3D 23+).

Currently, the viewport will draw: surface style (+RenderMode+ / +Texture+ / +ModelTransparency+), line display, outline, extension lines, endpoints, jitter, depth cues, back edges, various colors, ground/sky, section plane display, hidden geometry, environmental light shading, etc. Keys for fog, dimension/text display switches, and component editing transparency can be read and written but do not affect rendering at this time.

examples.code:
ro = ModraUp.active_model.rendering_options
  ro["ModelTransparency"] = true   # X-ray
  ro["RenderMode"]                 #=> 2

entries.name: ModraUp
entries.summary: Application entry points for accessing the active model, reading version information, registering extensions, opening files, and formatting units. This namespace follows the SketchUp Ruby API naming conventions.
notes: ModraUp and Sketchup reference the same module. Ruby class names retain the Sketchup prefix.

entries.name: active_model
entries.summary: The currently open model (the host contains only this instance).

entries.name: version
entries.summary: Declared SketchUp compatible version string (currently fixed to +"24.0.0"+).

entries.name: version_number
entries.summary: Version number (current +2400000000).

entries.name: app_name
entries.summary: Application Name, currently set to +`ModraUp`+.

entries.name: platform
entries.summary: Current operating system. macOS is denoted as +:platform_osx+, and Windows as +:platform_win+.

entries.name: register_extension
entries.summary: Register the {SketchupExtension}. When +load_at_start+ is true, its load path (specified by the second parameter +@path+ of {SketchupExtension.new}) is immediately +require"d.

entries.name: require
entries.summary: Loads Ruby files, supporting both +.rbe+ (RBS2.0) and old +.rbs+ (RBS1.0) formats. Returns +false+ if the file is not found or a +LoadError+ occurs; the old error strategy of the host application is maintained.

entries.name: load
entries.summary: Load Ruby files. Currently, behaves the same as {ModraUp.require}: the file will not be executed more than once; and it returns +false+ if the file is not found.
notes: Supports +.rbe+ (RBS2.0) and the older +.rbs+ (RBS1.0).

entries.name: is_pro?
entries.summary: Is Pro functionality enabled. Currently always true; otherwise, the DC Manager/Report functions will be disabled.
notes: ModraUp extension. No SketchUp authorization detection.

entries.name: is_online
entries.summary: Do you consider there to be an online connection? Currently, it is always set to false, with DC reports using local HTML.
notes: ModraUp extension. Does not perform true connectivity checking.

entries.name: get_datfile_info
entries.summary: Read keys from the SketchUp installation dat file. Return the default value if no dat file is found.
notes: ModraUp extension. Does not parse Trimble dat.

entries.name: get_i18n_datfile_info
entries.summary: Read the interface language dat file. Like {ModraUp.get_datfile_info}, it returns +default+ when no table is found.
notes: ModraUp extension. Does not parse Trimble language dat.

entries.name: temp_dir
entries.summary: Temporary directory (system temporary path).

entries.name: get_locale
entries.summary:
The current application language; uses the system language if no fixed language is set, following SketchUp style tags such as +"zh-CN"+, +"en-US"+. 
{LanguageHandler} extends the +Resources+ subdirectory using this name.

entries.name: os_language
entries.summary: System preferred language, unaffected by the application language setting.

entries.name: is_64bit?
entries.summary: Is the process 64-bit.

entries.name: mdi?
entries.summary: Is the multi-document interface. This host is single-document and always returns `false`.
notes: ModraUp extension. No Mac multi-window support.

entries.name: debug_mode?
entries.summary: Outputs API misuse warnings to the console. Currently, only the switch is saved; individual messages are not printed yet.

entries.name: debug_mode=
entries.summary: Sets the value reported by {ModraUp.debug_mode?}.

entries.name: plugins_disabled?
entries.summary: Does the plugin skip the Plugins directory's +.rb+ files on startup? This setting is defined in the {ModraUp.write_default} preference file and will take effect on the next startup.

entries.name: plugins_disabled=
entries.summary: Sets the flag returned by {ModraUp.plugins_disabled?}. Pass +true+ to disable the plugins directory.

entries.name: is_valid_filename?
entries.summary: Does the filename contain no path separators or Windows illegal characters.

entries.name: get_shortcuts
entries.summary:
Returns all shortcuts configured by the host, including user rebindings, multiple bindings for the same command, and plugin commands.

Each item is a key, tab, and command identifier (e.g., `selectLineTool:`); if no command identifier is present, the registered menu path is used.

Keys are represented in Qt PortableText format, preserving distinctions between modifiers like Ctrl and Meta, and do not force conversion to Windows key format.

HTML input temporarily suspends shortcut triggering without affecting the query; unbound commands are not output, and an empty array is returned if there is no host.

entries.name: get_resource_path
entries.summary: Find application resource files (LanguageHandler uses). In +$LOAD_PATH+, look for +Resources/en-US/filename+, then find the same-named file. If not found, return +nil+.

entries.name: format_length
entries.summary: Format the length according to the current model units (internal inches). The second parameter covers decimal places; a negative value will remove trailing zeros.

entries.name: format_angle
entries.summary: Format the angle in radians into a degree format used by the current model. Currently, it outputs in degrees with a decimal point, e.g., +.+.
notes: ModraUp extension. Still does not support model angle units (degrees, minutes, seconds) or regional decimal separators.

entries.name: format_degrees
entries.summary: Format a number that is already in degrees into an angle text (currently +"%.1f"+).

entries.name: format_area
entries.summary: Format the area according to the current model units. The parameter is in square inches.

entries.name: parse_length
entries.summary: Parse the length text into inches. Return +nil+ if parsing fails.

entries.name: format_volume
entries.summary: Format the volume using the current model's length unit. The parameter is in cubic inches.

entries.name: break_edges?
entries.summary: Does the line snap to intersect coplanar edges at the intersection point when breaking them? Defaults to +true+. The line tool reads this switch from the core +imprint_coplanar_line+.

entries.name: break_edges=
entries.summary: Set {ModraUp.break_edges?} to false to keep intersecting edges intact.

FILE_WRITE_OK = 0

{ModraUp::TextureWriter#write} succeeded. Top-level constant.

FILE_WRITE_FAILED_INVALID_TYPE = 1

{ModraUp::TextureWriter#write} encountered an unsupported entity type. Top-level constant.

entries.name: FILE_WRITE_FAILED_UNKNOWN

FILE_WRITE_FAILED_UNKNOWN = 2

{ModraUp::TextureWriter#write} failed due to various reasons such as not loaded or unable to write to the path. Top-level constant.

entries.name: create_texture_writer
entries.summary: Create a texture writer.

entries.name: add_observer
entries.summary:
Register application-level observers. Adding the same object a second time returns false.

When an observer implements `expectsStartupModelNotifications` and returns true, the plugin will receive the `onNewModel` notification after the plugin loads. New, open, and exit events are then dispatched by the host.

examples.code:
class MyApp < ModraUp::AppObserver
    def expectsStartupModelNotifications
      true
    end
    def onNewModel(model)
      model.tools
    end
  end
  ModraUp.add_observer(MyApp.new)

entries.name: remove_observer
entries.summary: Remove application-level observers. Returns +false+ if not registered.

entries.name: read_default
entries.summary: Read the persisted preferences and return the type written at the time (see {ModraUp.write_default}); if not written, return +default+.

examples.code:
ModraUp.write_default("Demo", "enabled", false)
  ModraUp.read_default("Demo", "enabled", true)  #=> false
  ModraUp.read_default("Demo", "missing", 3)     #=> 3

entries.name: write_default
entries.summary:
Persist preferences: save values by type, readable during the current session and written to disk on exit.

Like in SketchUp 2018 and later versions, they are stored in the user directory's +PrivatePreferences.json+ (macOS: +~/Library/Application Support/ModraUp 2026/ModraUp+; Windows: +%LOCALAPPDATA%\ModraUp\ModraUp 2026\ModraUp+).

Nil, true/false, Integer (64-bit or less), Float, String, and their composed Array, Hash are read back as-is; Lengths are stored as Float, Symbols as String, Hash keys as String, and other objects as their +to_s+ result.
raises: [ArgumentError] The value contains NaN or Infinity, or is nested more than 64 levels deep (including self-referencing).

entries.name: SB_PROMPT
entries.summary:
SB_PROMPT = 0

{ModraUp.set_status_text} written to the left status bar prompt. Top-level constant.

entries.name: SB_VCB_VALUE
entries.summary:
SB_VCB_VALUE = 1

{ModraUp.set_status_text} writes the VCB (Measurement Box) value. Top-level constant.

entries.name: SB_VCB_LABEL
entries.summary:
SB_VCB_LABEL = 2

{ModraUp.set_status_text} written to VCB label. Top-level constant.

entries.name: status_text=
entries.summary: Displays a prompt in the status bar on the left. Equivalent to {ModraUp.set_status_text}(text, SB_PROMPT). Ignored if there is no host.

entries.name: vcb_label=
entries.summary: VCB Label. Equivalent to {ModraUp.set_status_text}(label_text, SB_VCB_LABEL).

entries.name: vcb_value=
entries.summary: VCB value. Equivalent to {ModraUp.set_status_text}(value, SB_VCB_VALUE).

entries.name: set_status_text
entries.summary:
Set the status bar. Clear the left prompt, VCB label, and VCB value. 
+position+ can be {SB_PROMPT} (left prompt), {SB_VCB_LABEL} (VCB label), or {SB_VCB_VALUE} (VCB value).

entries.name: undo
entries.summary: Undo the previous operation on the current model.

entries.name: redo
entries.summary: Redoes the current model by executing the next step in the undo stack.

entries.name: file_new
entries.summary: Create a new document. When hosted, it follows the path of the "File / New" menu: if the document is dirty, ask to save first, then display the template dialog. If the user cancels saving or selects a template, the document remains unchanged. When not hosted, reset to the default millimeter template (1 m cube).

entries.name: open_file
entries.summary: Open a +.osk3d+ or +.skp+ file, or pass it to the importer registered by {ModraUp.register_importer}. Replace the current model. If the file does not exist, return +false+. For dirty documents, prompt the host to save; if the user cancels, return +false+. If +with_status+ is true, return {ModraUp::Model::LOAD_STATUS_SUCCESS} (importers return their {ModraUp::Importer::ImportSuccess} status, etc.). Ignore +show_version_warning_dialog+.

entries.name: quit
entries.summary: Exit the application. Follow the path of closing the window when there is a host (prompt to save dirty documents). Do nothing if there is no host.

entries.name: focus
entries.summary: Brings the main window to the foreground. Does nothing if there is no host.

entries.name: resize_viewport
entries.summary:
Resize the 3D viewport dimensions. After adjustment, {ModraUp::View#vpwidth} / {ModraUp::View#vpheight} aligns correctly.
+logical_pixels+: false when resizing by physical pixels; uses screen DPR when hosted, otherwise directly sets the model viewport.
notes: ModraUp extension. +logical_pixels+: is an extension keyword.

entries.name: template
entries.summary: The current template file path. It is an empty string if there is no host and no template is set.

entries.name: template=
entries.summary: Set the path for the template to be used next time a new model is created. Write the setting when there is a host.

entries.name: template_dir
entries.summary: Template directory. When hosted, it is located at +Templates+ under the application data directory.

entries.name: fix_shadow_strings?
entries.summary: Enhance face offsetting to reduce shadow stripe artifacts. Only affects polygon offsetting when there is no true shadow channel.

entries.name: fix_shadow_strings=
entries.summary: Toggle Shadow Stripes Correction.

entries.name: LocalExtensionManager
entries.summary: The underlying interface used by the host "Extension Manager" dialog: read the list of installed native extensions, uninstall them, and save preferences. Plugins should use {ModraUp.extensions} and {SketchupExtension} instead of relying on this module.
notes: ModraUp extension. SketchUp does not have this module.

entries.name: startup_states
entries.summary: Returns an independent copy of the extension and entry script enable states for use in startup policies and management.
notes: ModraUp extension.

entries.name: save_preferences
entries.summary: Write back the modified preferences (including extension enabled status) to the preference file immediately, performing an atomic replacement of the entire file.
notes: ModraUp extension.

entries.name: inventory_json
entries.summary: A JSON array listing installed extensions in the Plugins directory, with each item containing +id+, +name+, +loaders+ (top-level entry scripts, relative to the Plugins directory), +removable+, and +reason+ explaining why it cannot be uninstalled. When there is no host, it is +"[]"+.
notes: ModraUp extension.

entries.name: uninstall
entries.summary: Remove the files of an installed extension package based on the +id+ from {inventory_json}. The loaded code will only disappear after a restart.
raises: [RuntimeError] Package does not exist, is protected (+removable+ is false), deletion failed, or has no host.
notes: ModraUp extension.

examples.code:
require 'json'
  rows = JSON.parse(ModraUp::LocalExtensionManager.inventory_json)
  row = rows.find { |r| r['name'] == 'MyExtension' && r['removable'] }
  ModraUp::LocalExtensionManager.uninstall(row['id']) if row

entries.name: install_from_archive
entries.summary: Unzip the archive (either .rbz or .zip) to the Plugins directory and save the installation record. On restart, load the top-level entry. A default warning for third-party extensions will pop up; if the user cancels, throw {Interrupt}. If there is no host, return false.
notes: ModraUp extension. The second parameter +show_warning+ enables the extension.

entries.name: register_importer
entries.summary: Register the {ModraUp::Importer}. Afterward, the "Open / Import" dialog will display its file filter, and {ModraUp.open_file} will call the +load_file+ method when it corresponds to the extension.

examples.code:
class DemoImporter < ModraUp::Importer
    def description; "Demo"; end
    def file_extension; "demo"; end
    def id; "demo"; end
    def load_file(path, status); ImportSuccess; end
  end
  ModraUp.register_importer(DemoImporter.new)

entries.name: send_action
entries.summary:
Trigger an action. The string can include or exclude a trailing colon. Recognized actions: +showRubyPanel:+ (host console), standard views / zoom / perspective, built-in tools, +editUndo:+ / +editRedo:+, 
+pageAdd:+ / +pageDelete:+ / +pageUpdate:+ / +pageNext:+ / +pagePrevious:+, 
+renderWireframe:+ / +renderHiddenLine:+ / +renderMonochrome:+ / +renderShaded:+ / +renderTextures:+, 
+viewShowAxes:+ / +viewShowHidden:+ / +viewUndo:+, 
+fileNew:+ / +fileOpen:+ / +fileSave:+ (last two go through the host).
Integers are Windows command numbers, e.g., +10501+ for top view.

entries.name: display_name_from_action
entries.summary: Replace the {ModraUp.send_action} string with a short name. Remove the trailing colon from unknown names and return them unchanged.

entries.name: find_support_file
entries.summary: Find support files. When querying +"Plugins"+, omitting the directory or passing an empty string returns the user plugin directory. For other two-parameter calls, search for +directory/name+ in the plugin directory (prefix can be removed) and +$LOAD_PATH+.

params.name: directory
params.text: Subpath relative to the Plugins or user files root

entries.name: find_support_files
entries.summary: Lists files with matching extensions in the support directory. Omitting +directory+ returns an empty array.

params.name: extension
params.text: Does not contain points, for example, {+"rb"+}.

entries.name: extensions
entries.summary: Entries in the extensions table registered with {ModraUp.register_extension}.

entries.name: Tool
entries.summary:
Callback list for custom tools. SketchUp's official API does not have this class (cannot be written as
+class MyTool < ModraUp::Tool+), so it is implemented by duck typing, providing the necessary methods and then passing them to {ModraUp::Model#select_tool}.

ModraUp makes the same protocol into a browsable class for internal training: no inheritance is required; missing methods are skipped by the host. When determining if a tool has implemented a callback, it ignores the documentation stub methods in this class, consistent with SketchUp's duck typing. Dynamic Components' +DCInteractTool+ is an example of such a regular Ruby class.

Currently, it forwards: +activate+, +deactivate+, +suspend+, +resume+, +onSetCursor+, +draw+ (calls +getExtents+ before drawing), +onMouseMove+, left/middle/right mouse clicks and double-clicks, +onMouseWheel+ (returns +true+ to prevent viewport scaling), +onMouseEnter+, +onMouseLeave+, +onKeyDown+, +onKeyUp+, +onCancel+, +onReturn+, +enableVCB?+ / +onUserText+, +getMenu+. Middle mouse button still navigates the viewport. +getInstructorContentDirectory+ is queried at +activate+, and the HTML files in that directory are loaded when the "Instructor" window menu is opened.

Modifier key constants are found at {VK_SHIFT}, {CONSTRAIN_MODIFIER_MASK}, {COPY_MODIFIER_MASK}.
notes: ModraUp extension. SketchUp does not define the `+ModraUp::Tool+` class; this class is only used as a documentation index.

examples.title: duck type (recommended, similar to SketchUp)
examples.code:
class TipTool
    def activate
      ModraUp.set_status_text "tip"
    end
    def onMouseMove(flags, x, y, view)
      view.pick_helper.do_pick(x, y)
    end
  end
  defined?(ModraUp::Tool)  #=> true
  # ModraUp.active_model.select_tool(TipTool.new)

entries.name: active_tool
entries.summary: The current Ruby tool activated by {ModraUp::Model#select_tool} (protocol see {ModraUp::Tool}). Built-in C++ tools are +nil+.

entries.name: push_tool
entries.summary: Push the Ruby tool to the top of the stack, saving the current Ruby or built-in tool. If the Ruby tool implements +suspend(view)+, it will be suspended.

entries.name: pop_tool
entries.summary: Pop the current Ruby tool, restoring the stack to the previous Ruby or built-in tool; the Ruby tool will receive +resume+. Returns the popped Ruby tool. Returns nil if the current tool is built-in, and nil if the stack is empty, reverting to the select tool.

entries.name: active_tool_id
entries.summary: Current tool ID. The Ruby tool ID is 0. Built-in tools use SketchUp common IDs (select 21022, move 21048, scale 21236, etc.).

entries.name: active_tool_name
entries.summary: The current tool name. Ruby tools are named after their class names, while built-in tools are named in English.

entries.name: model
entries.summary: This tool manager belongs to the model.

entries.name: UVHelper
entries.summary: A UVQ point on a face. x/y/z represent U/V/Q; dividing by z gives UV. Created by {Face#get_UVHelper}.

entries.name: get_front_UVQ
entries.summary: Front UVQ. x/y/z for U/V/Q.

entries.name: get_back_UVQ
entries.summary: Back UVQ. x/y/z for U/V/Q.

entries.name: Vertex
entries.summary: Vertices. {Vertex#position} with topological queries (edge/faces/rings, {Vertex#used_by?}). The parent class is {ModraUp::Entity}, not {ModraUp::Drawingelement}.

entries.name: position
entries.summary: Vertex coordinates.

entries.name: common_edge
entries.summary: Edge between two points.

entries.name: curve_interior?
entries.summary: If the vertex is inside the curve (not an open arc endpoint), return the {ModraUp::ArcCurve}.

entries.name: edges
entries.summary: Return the edges that use this vertex.

entries.name: faces
entries.summary: Returns the faces that use this vertex.

entries.name: loops
entries.summary: Loops that pass through this vertex.

entries.name: used_by?
entries.summary: Does the vertex used by a given edge or face.

entries.name: Test
entries.summary: The hidden testing module for SketchUp.

entries.name: View
entries.summary:
Current viewport. Obtain it from {ModraUp::Model#active_view}.

+draw+ / +draw2d+ draw to the viewport during {ModraUp::Tool#draw} and when enabled {ModraUp::Overlay#draw} is active.
{#load_texture} loads an image into the host, returning +0+ on failure. {#animation=} advances the animation by one frame (+next+ or +nextFrame+).

examples.code:
view = ModraUp.active_model.active_view
  view.invalidate
  origin, dir = view.pickray(10, 10)

entries.name: ViewObserver
entries.summary:
Base class for View Observers. Subclasses implement +onViewChanged+ and +onScaleFactorChange+.

Registered with {ModraUp::View#add_observer}, +onViewChanged+ is called on pan/rotate/scale and viewport size changes. +onScaleFactorChange+ is called on display DPI or {UI.scale_factor}(view) changes.

examples.code:
class MyView < ModraUp::ViewObserver
    def onViewChanged(view)
      puts view.camera.eye
    end
    def onScaleFactorChange(view)
      puts UI.scale_factor(view)
    end
  end
  ModraUp.active_model.active_view.add_observer(MyView.new)

entries.name: onViewChanged
entries.summary: Called when the camera is translated, rotated, scaled, or when the viewport pixel size changes (includes dimensions since SketchUp 2019.2).

examples.code:
class MyView < ModraUp::ViewObserver
    def onViewChanged(view)
      view.invalidate
    end
  end
  ModraUp.active_model.active_view.add_observer(MyView.new)

entries.name: onScaleFactorChange
entries.summary: Called when the DPI of the screen containing the viewport changes, synchronizing with {UI.scale_factor(view)}.

examples.code:
class MyView < ModraUp::ViewObserver
    def onScaleFactorChange(view)
      UI.scale_factor(view)
    end
  end
  ModraUp.active_model.active_view.add_observer(MyView.new)

entries.name: pick_helper
entries.summary: The pick helper bound to this viewport. Calls {ModraUp::PickHelper#do_pick} with coordinates immediately.

entries.name: camera
entries.summary: Current viewport camera. Calling {ModraUp::Camera#set} on the returned object will change the viewport.

entries.name: camera=
entries.summary: Change the viewport camera to +camera+. The array's second item is the transition seconds, which is currently ignored and will switch immediately.

entries.name: model
entries.summary: The model to which this viewport belongs.

entries.name: pickray
entries.summary: Screen point corresponding world ray: [{Geom::Point3d} start point, {Geom::Vector3d} direction].

entries.name: screen_coords
entries.summary: Projects a world point onto the screen. Returns the point's +x+/+y+ coordinates as logical pixels; returns +nil+ on projection failure.

entries.name: tooltip
entries.summary: Viewport tooltip text displayed next to the cursor.

entries.name: tooltip=

entries.name: draw
entries.summary:
Draw 3D geometry. Valid in {ModraUp::Tool#draw} or an active {ModraUp::Overlay#draw}.
Share depth buffer with the model: hidden parts will not be drawn. Use {#draw2d} for screen pixels.
+:texture+ is a handle from {#load_texture}, and +:uvs+ corresponds one-to-one with vertices (x=u, y=v).
+:normals+ are accepted but currently drawn as flat surfaces without lighting.
Points can be {Geom::Point3d}, {Geom::Vector3d}, {Geom::Point2d}, +[x, y, z]+, or objects with +x+/+y+; +nil+ skips the point.
call_seq: view.draw(opengl_const, *points, texture: id, uvs: uvs) -> view

entries.name: draw2d
entries.summary:
Draw primitives on screen coordinates. Valid in {ModraUp::Tool#draw} or an enabled {ModraUp::Overlay#draw}.
Draws on top of the model and 3D {#draw} without depth testing.
Point types are the same as in {#draw}; +nil+ skips the draw.
call_seq: view.draw2d(opengl_const, *points, texture: id, uvs: uvs) -> view

entries.name: draw_polyline
entries.summary: Same as {#draw_line}.

entries.name: draw_lines
entries.summary: Draw line segments by points. The point types are the same as for #draw; +nil+ skips the point.

entries.name: draw_points
entries.summary: Draw screen points. +style+: 1 empty square, 2 solid square, 3 cross, 4 plus, 5 star, 6 empty triangle, 7 solid triangle.

entries.name: draw_text
entries.summary:
Draw text on the screen coordinates. The +options+ can contain :font, :size, :pixel_size, :point_size, :bold, :align, :vertical_align, and :color. 

The +:color+ can be a {ModraUp::Color}, [r, g, b], a color name, or a CSS hexadecimal value (e.g., "#1A1A1A").

entries.name: text_bounds
entries.summary:
Calculate the text box in screen coordinates for {#draw_text}. The +point+ is in viewport pixels (Z ignored).
The +options+ can include :font, :size, :pixel_size, :point_size, :bold, :align, :vertical_align.

Without a Qt host, use fixed-width font estimation to ensure non-empty strings have positive +width+ and +height+.

examples.code:
view = ModraUp.active_model.active_view
  b = view.text_bounds([0, 0, 0], "Hi")
  b.is_a?(Geom::Bounds2d)  #=> true
  b.width > 0 && b.height > 0  #=> true

entries.name: load_texture

Load an image as a texture into the viewport, returning a handle. Returns +0+ if the file does not exist, cannot be decoded, is an empty {ModraUp::ImageRep}, or has no host.
{#draw} / {#draw2d} can apply the +:texture+ and +:uvs+ to polygons.

entries.name: write_image
entries.summary:
Write the current 3D frame buffer as an image. Returns +false+ if host fails or capture fails.

+options+ key +:filename+ / +:width+ / +:height+ / +:antialias+ / +:compression+; +:transparent+ is ignored.
call_seq: view.write_image(filename, width = vpwidth, height = vpheight, antialias = false, compression = 1.0) -> Boolean
notes: ModraUp extension. Does not include a QPainter overlay; anti-aliasing only takes effect during zoom.

entries.name: SketchupExtension
entries.summary: Metadata for a Ruby extension. The host loads the implementation in +app/resources/Tools/modraup_extensions.rb+ at startup. Plugin code can require +extensions.rb+ for compatibility. Pass the extension to {ModraUp.register_extension} to register it and optionally load it immediately.

examples.code:
ext = SketchupExtension.new("Demo", File.join(__dir__, "main.rb"))
  ext.description = "demo"
  ext.version = "1.0.0"
  ModraUp.register_extension(ext, true)

entries.name: check
entries.summary: Check the extension. If not registered, {ModraUp.require} +@path+; if registered, call {ModraUp.register_extension}. Returns +true+ if already loaded.

entries.name: uncheck
entries.summary: Call {ModraUp.register_extension}(self, false) when registered to prevent automatic loading on the next startup. If not registered, it does nothing. The scripts executed in the current process will not be unloaded.

entries.name: loaded?
entries.summary: Has the Ruby Sketchup extension already been +require+?

entries.name: load_on_start?
entries.summary: Returns whether the extension loads automatically on startup (checked state in Extension Manager).

entries.name: version_id

It reads the +.strings+ file by locale; if the file or entry is missing, {#GetString} / {#[]} falls back to the key.
