entries.name: Layout
entries.summary:
Paper-space drawing API, named after the LayOut Ruby API. Access the document through {ModraUp::Model#layout_document}. Drawings are saved with the model, separately from model attributes. Standalone opening or saving of +.layout+ files is unsupported.

Sheet coordinates, dimensions, paper sizes, margins, and model points ({Geom::Point3d}) use inches. Use expressions such as +20.mm+ for other units. Line weights, arrow sizes, and font sizes use points. View scale is a ratio (1:50 is 0.02).

Each edit creates an undo step. To group edits, enclose them in {ModraUp::Model#start_operation} and {ModraUp::Model#commit_operation}. Call {ModraUp::Model#abort_operation} to revert the operation. When the drawing workspace is open, new views render in the background. Calls without an application host raise +NotImplementedError+.
notes: ModraUp extension. The names are taken from a subset of LayOut's official API; capabilities not present in LayOut (model embedding ports, single-component viewports, sections and details, visible lines, title blocks) are individually noted in the methods.

examples.title: Create a sheet and place a scene view on it
examples.code:
doc = ModraUp.active_model.layout_document
  page = doc.pages.add("Floor plan")
  scene = ModraUp.active_model.pages.add("Ground floor")
  view = Layout::SketchUpModel.new(scene, Geom::Bounds2d.new(20.mm, 20.mm, 250.mm, 180.mm))
  view.scale = 1.0 / 100
  doc.add_entity(view, doc.layers.active, page)

examples.title: Drawing sheet and title block
examples.code:
doc = ModraUp.active_model.layout_document
  doc.pages.add("Floor plan")
  info = doc.page_info                # document-wide settings
  info.width  = 420.mm
  info.height = 297.mm
  info.left_margin = 10.mm            # apply to all four sides
  doc.title_block["project"] = "Example residence"

examples.title: Create an elevation and an associated overall dimension for a component in one undo step
examples.code:
model = ModraUp.active_model
  doc = model.layout_document
  page = doc.pages.add
  cabinet = model.entities.add_group
  cabinet.entities.add_face([0, 0, 0], [600.mm, 0, 0], [600.mm, 400.mm, 0], [0, 400.mm, 0]).pushpull(-800.mm)
  model.start_operation("Cabinet elevation", true)
  front = Layout::SketchUpModel.new(cabinet, Geom::Bounds2d.new(290.mm, 20.mm, 110.mm, 90.mm))
  front.view = Layout::SketchUpModel::FRONT_VIEW
  front.scale = 1.0 / 20
  doc.add_entity(front, doc.layers.active, page)
  bb = cabinet.bounds
  p1, p2 = bb.corner(0), bb.corner(1)
  dim = Layout::LinearDimension.new(front.model_to_paper_point(p1), front.model_to_paper_point(p2), -8.mm)
  dim.connect(Layout::ConnectionPoint.new(front, p1), Layout::ConnectionPoint.new(front, p2))
  dim.set_attribute("auto_dim", "source", cabinet.persistent_id)
  doc.add_entity(dim, doc.layers.active, page)
  model.commit_operation

examples.code:
doc = ModraUp.active_model.layout_document
  page = doc.pages.add
  title = Layout::FormattedText.new("Ground-floor plan  1:100", Geom::Point2d.new(20.mm, 205.mm),
                                    Layout::FormattedText::ANCHOR_TYPE_TOP_LEFT)
  s = title.style
  s.font_size = 14
  title.style = s
  doc.add_entity(title, doc.layers.active, page)

entries.name: initialize
entries.summary: Create a linear dimension. +height+ is the distance from the dimension line to the start point, with a positive value on the left side of the direction from start to end (above the dimension line when annotated from left to right).

entries.name: connect
entries.summary: Connect two endpoints to model points in the viewport, one step undoable (takes effect upon addition if not already added). If one end is nil, it is not associated. During writing, recalculate the paper position and value based on the viewport.

entries.summary: Disconnect the association, leaving the dimension in its current position; a single undo step.

entries.name: initialize
entries.summary: Create a leader. The arrowhead is at the +target_point+, and the text is anchored at the +anchor_point+ (or the midpoint of the text box near the arrowhead); break points are automatically placed 5 mm above the anchor point on the same horizontal line toward the arrowhead direction.

entries.name: AngularDimension
entries.summary:
Angle Dimension: The angle between two edges, with the arc of the dimension centered at the intersection of the two dimension lines. The connection points are on the edges being measured, and the extension points are at the ends of the arc. The value is the paper angle (in degrees), with the text, endpoints, and height sharing the same naming style as other dimensions.

  +end_offset_length=+2 mm (the dimension line is fixed 2 mm away from the measured point); cannot +connect+ (as in LayOut), instead, it is only associated when using the angle dimension tool to mark viewport model lines on the drawing sheet.
notes: ModraUp extension. Does not support +entities+, +leader_line_type+, and +start_offset_length=.

examples.title: Measure 45°
examples.code:
dim = Layout::AngularDimension.new(Geom::Point2d.new(3, 2), Geom::Point2d.new(2.5, 1.5),
                                     Geom::Point2d.new(3, 2), Geom::Point2d.new(2.707, 1.293), true)
  dim.angle.radians  #=> 45.0

entries.name: initialize
entries.summary: Create an angular dimension. The +start_point+ and +end_point+ are points on the measured edges, while the +start_extent_point+ and +end_extent_point+ are the endpoints of the dimension arc. The intersection of the two dimension lines (from the measured points to the extent points) is the center of the dimension arc, and the radius is the distance from the center to the +start_extent_point+.
call_seq: Layout::AngularDimension.new(start_point, end_point, start_extent_point, end_extent_point, inner_angle) -> Layout::AngularDimension

params.name: inner_angle
params.text: false AngularDimension (360° minus the angle between two rays)

raises: [ArgumentError] The dimension leaders are parallel, or the dimension arc is too small.

entries.summary: The angle measured in radians.

entries.name: radius
entries.summary: The distance from the center to the dimension arc.

entries.name: LockedEntityError
entries.summary: Raised when modifying a locked entity. ModraUp currently provides this class for compatibility with LayOut plugins. Object-level locking is unavailable.

entries.name: Document
entries.summary: A layout document embedded within a model. Each model has one, obtained via {ModraUp::Model#layout_document}; accessing it after the model is closed throws a +TypeError+. The layout is saved with the model and does not have a separate +.layout+ file.
notes: ModraUp extension. A LayOut Document corresponds to a +.layout+ file; here it corresponds to the model's separately saved drawing sheet data.

entries.name: templates
entries.summary: Lists system drawing templates and user +.osklt+ files, excluding the built-in blank template. Each entry is a Hash with string keys +"name"+ and +"path"+. System and user templates are each sorted by filename. Use {#apply_template} to apply a template.
notes: ModraUp extension. LayOut selects the template when creating a document with +Document.new(template_path)+; here, the document already exists with the model.

entries.name: apply_template
entries.summary:
Apply a template to a document that has no drawings: import the page size, margins, border frames, grids, dynamic text, title block fields, layers, dimension styles, and page objects from the template; subsequently, {Layout::Pages#add} new pages will use the paper size and objects from the first interior page of the template. Templates without a cover page will use the first page.

These settings are overall taken from the template: any layers, grids, and title block fields added to the document are replaced, except for their extended attributes ({#set_attribute}). One-step undo.

params.name: name_or_path
params.text: List the names or the +.osklt+ file paths. Prioritize user templates with the same name as system templates by name.

raises: [ArgumentError] The document already has a drawing sheet, or the template was not found or is invalid.
notes: ModraUp extension. Corresponds to LayOut +Layout::Document.new({template_path})+.

examples.code:
doc = ModraUp.active_model.layout_document
  doc.apply_template("A3 Architectural") if doc.pages.length == 0
  doc.pages.add("Plan")

entries.name: add_entity
entries.summary: Place the newly created object on the drawing sheet, with one-step undo. If no `+page+` is given, `+layer+` must be a shared layer. If the object extends beyond the sheet edges, it is clipped back within the sheet boundaries. If the object is larger than the sheet, an `ArgumentError` is raised. After placement, the object's bounds can be retrieved using `{Layout::Entity#bounds}`.

params.name: entity

raises: [ArgumentError] The object is already in the document, larger than the sheet, or the layer is not a shared layer when added without specifying a page.
[Layout::LockedLayerError] Layer is locked or hidden on this page
[RuntimeError] The data for a single object exceeds 1 MB

entries.name: export
entries.summary:
Exports sheets to PDF using the same process as the Export dialog. Missing or stale model views in the selected range are updated before the file is written. Failure, cancellation, or a model change during export preserves the original file. The call returns immediately. On completion, the block receives +ok+, indicating whether the file was written, and +message+, the result shown in the interface. On success the message includes vector and raster view counts. On failure it gives the reason. The block may call +export+ again.

Option keys may be strings or symbols. +start_page+ and +end_page+ select a 1-based inclusive range, defaulting to all sheets. +update_views+ defaults to true. When false, the exporter reuses previews, except that it still renders views with size or camera mismatches. +prefer_vector+ defaults to true and prioritizes vector lines and annotations. The exporter accepts +output_resolution+, +compress_images+, and +compress_quality+ without applying them. +update_views+ and +prefer_vector+ are ModraUp extensions.
yields: @yieldparam [Boolean] ok whether the file was written
raises: [ArgumentError] not a +.pdf+, page index out of bounds, document has no drawings or unknown option name
[RuntimeError] Not a active model's drawing, or an export is already in progress.
notes: ModraUp extension. LayOut's +export+ runs synchronously and supports PNG and other formats. ModraUp exports PDF only.

doc = ModraUp.active_model.layout_document
  doc.export(File.join(Dir.tmpdir, "drawings.pdf")) do |ok, message|
    puts ok ? "Exported" : "Export failed: #{message}"
  end

entries.name: Image
entries.summary: Images on drawings (png, jpg, bmp, gif, webp, tif, svg). They are managed in a reference mode: the model only records the file path (relative or absolute), size, and modification time; it does not store pixel data. If the file is moved or deleted, a placeholder is displayed on the drawing. Rotation is controlled with {Layout::Entity#rotation=}, and cropping is managed with {#clip_mask=}.

Clipping Mask: The image is displayed only within the shape. Returns a copy of the shape (in paper coordinates) not in the document; when there is no mask, it returns nil.

After adding the image to the document, an axial corner mask returns a Layout::Rectangle, while others return a Layout::Path.

entries.name: SketchUpModel
entries.summary: Model Viewport: Displays a scene, or a single component or group (independent viewport). Parallel projection viewports have a fixed scale and can project model points, associated dimensions, sections, and details. When the drawing workspace is open, new and modified viewports are automatically plotted in the background.
notes: ModraUp extension. The source must be from this model's scene or instance; it cannot reference an external +.skp+ file. There is no synchronized rendering; attempting to use {#render} will raise a +NotImplementedError+.

entries.name: create_section
entries.summary:
Generate a section view from the current viewport, with one undo step, resulting in the same outcome as the section tool: a new viewport with section numbers, and the original viewport with a section cut symbol. The points +first+ and +second+ are the model points at the ends of the section line, which should project as a line in the current viewport (at least 0.1 mm long); the section plane contains this line and the viewing direction of the current viewport. The +look+ parameter specifies the viewing direction of the section, pointing to the retained side.

If +position+ is not provided, the tool will arrange the section views according to its rules: first try right, left, down, and up, then move the original viewport overall, and if it still cannot fit, create a new sheet of the same size.
call_seq: viewport.create_section(first, second, look, depth: nil, position: nil, page: nil) -> Layout::SketchUpModel

params.name: look
params.text: The observation direction forms an angle of at least approximately 1° with the section plane.

params.name: depth
params.text: Retained depth (model inches); nil for unlimited

params.name: position
params.text: Center of the new view (in sketch units); raise an error if it extends beyond the paper.

params.name: page
params.text: Place it on which drawing sheet; default is the page of the current viewport.

raises: [ArgumentError] The perspective viewport is too short, the section plane is too short, the view direction is within the section plane, or the position does not fit.
notes: ModraUp extension.

examples.code:
model = ModraUp.active_model
  box = model.entities.add_group
  box.entities.add_face([0, 0, 0], [40, 0, 0], [40, 20, 0], [0, 20, 0]).pushpull(-30)
  doc = model.layout_document
  top = Layout::SketchUpModel.new(box, Geom::Bounds2d.new(20.mm, 20.mm, 110.mm, 70.mm))
  doc.add_entity(top, doc.layers.active, doc.pages.add)
  bb = box.bounds
  c = bb.center
  section = top.create_section(Geom::Point3d.new(bb.min.x - 2, c.y, c.z),
                               Geom::Point3d.new(bb.max.x + 2, c.y, c.z),
                               Geom::Vector3d.new(0, 1, 0), depth: bb.height / 2 + 2)
  section.scale = 1.0 / 20

entries.name: create_detail
entries.summary: Generate a detail drawing from this viewport, with one undo step, similar to the detail tool: create a region bounded by two model points in the current viewport and scale it to a larger proportion at +position+, adding the detail frame to the current viewport.
call_seq: viewport.create_detail(corner1, corner2, scale: nil, position:, page: nil) -> Layout::SketchUpModel

params.name: scale
params.text: Ratio; nil for the smallest common scale that is at least doubled.

params.name: position
params.text: Center new view (on drawing sheet inches)

params.name: page
params.text: The default is the drawing sheet containing the current viewport.

raises: [ArgumentError] The area is too small to fit the paper or perspective viewport.
notes: ModraUp extension.

entries.name: select_tool
entries.summary:
Select the paper tool. +tool+ must be an object (with the same name and parameters) that implements ModraUp::Tool callback methods ({ModraUp::Tool.activate}, {ModraUp::Tool.deactivate}, {ModraUp::Tool.onMouseMove}, {ModraUp::Tool.onLButtonDown}, {ModraUp::Tool.onLButtonUp}, {ModraUp::Tool.onLButtonDoubleClick}, {ModraUp::Tool.onRButtonDown}, {ModraUp::Tool.onRButtonUp}, {ModraUp::Tool.onKeyDown}, {ModraUp::Tool.onKeyUp}, {ModraUp::Tool.onReturn}, {ModraUp::Tool.onCancel}, {ModraUp::Tool.onUserText}, {ModraUp::Tool.enableVCB?}, {ModraUp::Tool.draw}). The +view+ parameter in the callback is a Layout::PaperView, and +x+ and +y+ are logical pixels within the paper area, which can be converted to paper coordinates using Layout::PaperView#paper_point. Entering this tool will take you to the drawing workspace; passing +nil+ will return to the document selection tool.

The paper tool does not affect 3D tools in the model. The +deactivate+ method is called when space is pressed, the built-in drawing tool is selected, the model is selected, or the document is switched. Middle mouse drag and scroll wheel zoom are still handled by the paper tool.
raises: [RuntimeError] The document is not for the active model, or there are unfinished edits in the viewport.
notes: ModraUp extension. LayOut's Ruby API does not have a tool.

examples.title: Click the viewport to print the paper coordinates at the click location.
examples.code:
class PickTool
    def onLButtonDown(flags, x, y, view)
      pt = view.paper_point(x, y, true)
      entity = view.pick_entity(x, y)
      puts "#{pt.x.to_mm.round(1)}, #{pt.y.to_mm.round(1)} mm: #{entity.class}"
    end
    def draw(view)
      view.drawing_color = "red"
      view.line_width = 2
      view.draw(GL_LINE_LOOP, [[10.mm, 10.mm], [60.mm, 10.mm], [60.mm, 40.mm], [10.mm, 40.mm]])
    end
  end
  ModraUp.active_model.layout_document.select_tool(PickTool.new)

entries.name: tool
entries.summary: The currently selected viewport tool; nil if none is selected.

entries.name: PaperView
entries.summary: The paper view callback receives the +view+: it handles the conversion between paper pixels and paper coordinates (in inches), picks objects, and draws a preview in +draw(view)+. The drawing coordinates are in paper inches (e.g., +20.mm+), with line widths, point sizes, and font sizes in pixels. The drawing methods only take effect within +draw(view)+; otherwise, calling them has no effect.
notes: ModraUp extension.

entries.name: paper_point
entries.summary: The pixel coordinates on the paper plane in inches, with the origin at the top-left corner of the paper, and +y+ directed downward. When +snap+ is true, it snaps to the endpoints, midpoints, intersections, centers, edge points of paper objects, and visible model lines within visible viewports (model lines in viewports must be generated in the background before snapping).

entries.name: add_observer
entries.summary:
Add a drawing observer. Observers need only implement the methods they are interested in, with the first parameter always being the document:

- +onDocumentChanged(document)+: The drawing definition is modified, including UI edits, Ruby writes, undo, and redo.
- +onSelectionChanged(document)+: The sheet selection changes, see {#selection}.
- +onActivePageChanged(document, page)+: The current drawing changes, +page+ may be +nil+.
- +onWorkspaceChanged(document, active)+: Entering (+true+) or leaving (+false+) the drawing workspace.
- +onViewsUpdated(document)+: A batch of model views are updated in the background (excluding exports).
- +onExportComplete(document, path, ok, message)+: The PDF export is complete, including UI-initiated exports.

Notifications are delivered in the event loop at a later time, and multiple consecutive changes may be merged into one. Only the document currently displayed in the drawing workspace (the active model) receives notifications; switching documents does not send notifications. Observers are automatically removed when the model is closed.

returns.text: Returns false if a new observer is not added (returns +false+ if the same object is added again).

notes: ModraUp extension. LayOut's Ruby API does not support observers.

examples.code:
class MyDrawingObserver
    def onDocumentChanged(doc)
      puts "Drawing contains #{doc.pages.length} pages"
    end
    def onExportComplete(doc, path, ok, message)
      puts ok ? "Exported #{path}" : message
    end
  end
  ModraUp.active_model.layout_document.add_observer(MyDrawingObserver.new)

entries.name: remove_observer
entries.summary: Remove the document observer.
notes: ModraUp extension.

examples.code:
doc = ModraUp.active_model.layout_document
  observer = Object.new
  doc.add_observer(observer)
  doc.remove_observer(observer)

entries.name: selection
entries.summary: The current selection in the drawing workspace consists of the primary paper objects. If the document is not the current document being displayed in the workspace, the selection is an empty array.
notes: ModraUp extension.

entries.name: selection=
entries.summary: Set the sheet selection. Accept an object, array of objects, or +nil+ (to clear). The objects must be on the same drawing sheet (objects on shared layers are considered on each sheet); if not on the current sheet, switch to that sheet. This does not affect the undo history.
raises: [ArgumentError] The objects are not on the same drawing sheet, or belong to another document.
[Layout::LockedLayerError] The object is on a locked or hidden layer in the document.
[RuntimeError] The document is not for the active model, or there are unfinished edits in the viewport.
notes: ModraUp extension.

examples.title: Select the newly generated dimension.
examples.code:
doc = ModraUp.active_model.layout_document
  page = doc.active_page
  doc.selection = page.entities.grep(Layout::LinearDimension) if page

entries.name: active_page
entries.summary: The drawing sheet currently displayed in the Layout::Document active_page. Returns +nil+ if the document is not the active page or there is no drawing sheet.
notes: ModraUp extension.

entries.name: active_page=
entries.summary: Displays a different sheet in the drawing workspace and clears the paper-space selection. This change does not add an undo step.
raises: [RuntimeError] The document is not for the active model, or there are unfinished edits in the viewport.
notes: ModraUp extension.
